name: bridge-mcp
description: Secure SSH bridge for AI-powered remote server management. 476 tools across 77 groups covering Linux, Windows, Docker, Kubernetes, and more. MCP 2026-07-28 (Modern) only.

protocol_notes.notifications: opt-in via subscriptions/listen; every notification carries _meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId"]
protocol_notes.legacy_initialize: stdio: -32022 { supported: ["2026-07-28"] }. HTTP: 400 + -32020 HeaderMismatch, because the POST carries no Mcp-Method and header validation precedes version support. Pre-Modern clients cannot fall forward on either transport.
protocol_notes.http: POST /mcp only; GET and DELETE return 405 with Allow: POST. MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name are REQUIRED; a missing or contradicting header is 400 + -32020. JSON-RPC batching is refused (400 + -32600). No Mcp-Session-Id, no Last-Event-ID, no stream resumption. subscriptions/listen answers text/event-stream on its own POST body.

io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks.description: Async task execution. Declared under capabilities.extensions in the server/discover result rather than as a core capability. Task-augmented tool calls return a task handle that the client polls; the handle is also what the server may return unsolicited for a long-running call.

progressive_discovery.description: Three meta-tools let clients discover the registry on demand instead of loading all 476 schemas up front. Call mcp_list_tool_groups first (~77 entries), then mcp_search_tools to narrow by keyword, then mcp_describe_tool for the one full schema you need. All three are read-only and argument-validated locally.

data_reduction.description: Server-side output reduction to minimize token consumption. Each tool declares an OutputKind (RawText/Tabular/Json/Yaml/Auto) that determines which params apply. Call describe-tool or inspect the tool schema to see the exact Reduction Strategy per tool.

params.jq_filter: jq expression applied server-side to JSON output (Json/Auto kinds)
params.yq_filter: jq expression applied server-side to YAML output (Yaml/Auto kinds)
params.columns: Case-insensitive column filter for tabular output (Tabular/Auto kinds)
params.limit: Cap rows/array elements (all kinds except RawText)
params.output_format: 'json' (default) or 'tsv' for 60-80% token savings on list data
params.save_output: Persist full untruncated output to a file path

pagination.description: Truncated outputs return an output_id; call ssh_output_fetch output_id=<id> offset=<N> to retrieve the rest
